site.name: WaxWingFPV
site.title: WaxWingFPV | Cinematic FPV Drone Filming in Istanbul
site.tagline: Cinematic FPV films that show your space from a new perspective.
site.description: WaxWingFPV creates cinematic FPV drone videos for cafés, restaurants, shops and local businesses in Istanbul. Flights are conducted by a licensed pilot in accordance with applicable Turkish SHGM regulations.
site.ogAlt: An FPV drone flight over a street in Istanbul, with The Nish Coffee sign visible on the left.

work.heading: Projects
work.intro: We deliver two formats as standard: a landscape film for widescreen viewing and a vertical reel for social media.

kit.heading: Equipment
kit.intro: Two drones, each suited to different spaces and creative goals. Explore their strengths, ideal uses and limitations.

services.heading: Services
services.intro: We start every project by understanding your space and planning the right approach for your goals.

process.heading: Our process
process.intro: Five clear steps, from the first conversation to final delivery. See what happens at each stage and what we need from you.

trust.heading: Flight safety and permissions
trust.built: We built and tuned our own 5-inch FPV drone using a Mario 5 frame, a Mamba MK4 F722 flight controller stack and F40 V2 motors, rather than buying a ready-to-fly model.
trust.checklist: Before every shoot, we work through a written preflight safety checklist.
trust.licenceBody: Flights are conducted by a licensed pilot in accordance with applicable Turkish SHGM regulations.
